title: urnetwork / sim-latency automation
description: Internal v2 control-plane health. Reward receipt is not a chain settlement or a source approval. No candidate identities or embargoed scores are queried.

panels.title: sealed, awaiting publication
panels.description: Frozen reveal time still protects these sealed inventories. This is not an early leaderboard.

panels.title: reward events awaiting receipt
panels.description: Only published events count. A receipt acknowledges integration delivery, not irreversible payment, honesty approval, or safe source.

panels.title: oldest unacknowledged reward event
panels.description: Warn after five minutes. Reconcile the cursor feed and idempotent receipt before retrying; never create a replacement election to retry delivery.

panels.title: source activation intents pending
panels.description: Source approval and exact readiness receipts are required independently of provisional reward selection. Pending intents are not an active incumbent.

panels.title: supervisor durable heartbeat age
panels.description: Latest supervisor lease heartbeat; -1 means none registered. Warn above 30 seconds only while a supervisor is expected. The supervisor exits after the sixth seal. A stale lease cannot authorize source activation.

panels.title: independent capability holds
panels.description: A hold pauses only the named capability. Incident safety holds need an independently authorized recovery, not ordinary winner approval. Accepted evidence remains intact.

panels.title: retained integrity incidents
panels.description: Historical incidents in this scope, not a count of dishonest miners. Invalidation does not rewrite measurements or turn an infrastructure trust failure into no improvement.
